zh.summary: 把規則決定、程式修改、工具執行與成果驗收分開，讓 AI 協作任務有明確的負責人、可用權限與停止條件。
objectives: 區分模型產生的建議、工具實際做過的操作與已驗證的結果。
替一個收件檢核修改任務分配人與 Agent 的責任。
寫出可修改範圍、驗收依據與遇到歧義時的停止條件。

readingGuide.goal: 為一次 Agent 修改任務建立清楚的人機分工與驗收契約。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 先想一條規格：缺少文件類型時，不得匯出完整報告。
readingGuide.route: 先分配責任，再追蹤規格、修改、執行與驗收；最後寫出任務契約。
readingGuide.output: problem.md 的責任分工附錄與一份可審查的 Agent 任務契約。

sections.heading: 同一句「完成」，可能指不同的事
paragraphs: 這裡的 Coding Agent 指能依指令協助讀取專案、修改程式及呼叫工具的軟體代理；它實際能做什麼，取決於工具與環境設定。
你請 Coding Agent 修改收件網站，回覆寫著「已完成欄位驗證」。這句話可能只代表它產生了程式，也可能代表它已修改檔案並執行測試。要知道現在能交付什麼，還要看修改檔案、實際命令、輸出與適用範圍。
本課沿用三欄合成案例：申請編號、申請人代號、文件類型。目標是缺少任一必要欄位時，指出缺漏並阻擋完整報告。Agent 可以協助實作這條規則；哪些欄位必填、完整代表什麼，仍要由負責需求的人確認。

sections.heading: 像把一份工作交給新加入的同事
paragraphs: 新同事可能熟悉寫程式，卻不熟悉你所在單位的收件規則。你不會只說「把它做好」，而會提供工作目的、可參考文件、能修改的範圍，以及遇到什麼問題要先停下來詢問。AI 協作也需要這些條件。
這個類比用來說明委派契約。Agent 的流暢回答不會自動取得領域知識、資料使用權或發布權；你需要從可觀察的操作與作品判斷它實際完成了哪些工作。

sections.heading: 規則、執行與驗收各有負責人
paragraphs: 可以把任務拆成需求決策、程式修改、執行環境與成果驗收。這些責任有時由同一位學員兼任，但仍要逐項說清楚。測試程式會檢查某些條件，最終是否符合工作需要，則要對照已確認的需求。 Diff 是修改前後的差異清單，用來核對程式實際變動。
NIST AI RMF 1.0 的 GOVERN 2.1 與 3.2 提醒組織明確記錄角色、溝通與人機分工。這裡採其責任清楚的原則，將它轉成課堂工作分配；不是取得框架認證或宣稱已符合所有治理要求。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜本課的角色分配範例
rows: 決定規則
學員扮演需求負責人，確認三欄與完整的定義
problem.md、spec.md 的規則及理由
提出及修改程式
Agent 依規格提出 Diff；學員審查
指定檔案的變更與決策紀錄
執行工具
環境只開放任務所需工具；操作者核對實際呼叫
命令、退出結果與測試輸出
判定可交付範圍
學員核對規格、重演操作，必要時請同儕試用
驗收結果、限制與下一步

sections.heading: 從建議走到證據，需要哪些連結
paragraphs: 模型可以提出測試命令，但文字裡出現「pytest 通過」與工具真的執行過 pytest 是兩件可分別核對的事。你要找到命令在哪個目錄、對哪個版本執行，以及輸出是否涵蓋這次變更。
例如只驗證「空字串會被拒絕」，仍未證明「先填完整、之後清空欄位」會讓舊報告失效。驗收者應挑選能反駁成功主張的案例，重現它，再看修改是否真的修正問題。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜一次可審查的 Agent 任務
blocks.description: 編號表示交付依據；任何一步發現歧義，都可回到規格修訂。

items.title: 確認規格
items.body: 人先定義必要欄位、完整狀態與不做事項。

items.title: 委派有限修改
items.body: Agent 只修改指定檔案；新規則或額外服務先提出問題。

items.title: 檢查實際執行
items.body: 核對 Diff、工具命令、測試輸出與修改版本。

items.title: 判定與保留界線
items.body: 人重演目標任務，記錄通過情境及未驗證範圍。

sections.heading: 指令、權限與停止條件要一起設定
paragraphs: 指令中的「不要修改其他檔案」表達工作範圍；檔案權限、沙箱（限制程式可接觸資源的執行環境）與工具允許清單才決定系統是否能限制越界操作。單靠文字提醒，不能作為隔離已生效的證據。學員應核對實際環境，給 Agent 完成本次工作所需的最小權限。
這次任務可允許讀取 problem.md、spec.md，修改 app.py、rules.py 與指定測試；不需要正式資料、帳號秘密、對外發布或外部付費服務。若它認為必須新增必填欄位、安裝未核對依賴，或修改範圍以外的檔案，就先列出理由與影響，等需求負責人決定。

blocks.caption: 表 2｜可直接交給 Agent 的任務契約
rows: 目標
缺少文件類型時，顯示缺漏並拒絕完整匯出
依據
使用目前 spec.md；不要自行新增業務規則
修改範圍
app.py、rules.py、tests/ 中與本情境有關的檔案
驗收
缺漏、完整、空白及舊結果失效情境；附真實命令結果
停止條件
規格歧義、需用真實資料、超出檔案或網路權限
交付
Diff、實際執行紀錄、未完成事項；由人確認可交付範圍

sections.heading: 「人會審核」要變成可以操作的安排
paragraphs: 如果人只看到一段成功摘要，沒有時間、工具或足夠資訊檢查，那麼「最後有人按確認」仍不足以說明審查有效。請把審查對象縮成一次切片：先比對一條規格與一份 Diff，再重演一個會失敗的案例。
另一個常見錯誤是將 Agent 的錯誤當成只能重新問一次。你可以先保留錯誤輸入與輸出，指出和規格差在哪裡，再請它修正並重跑。若問題涉及必要欄位的業務定義，就回到需求負責人決策；增加提示長度不會自動解決規則分歧。

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器與本課合成收件情境；不需開通 Agent 或外部服務。
steps: 在 problem.md 加入責任分工小節，分配規則決定、程式修改、工具操作與驗收。
依表 2 寫一份 Agent 任務契約，指定一條缺漏情境與可修改檔案。
假設收到「已完成」摘要，列出還需要哪些命令、Diff 或操作證據，才能判定這條情境通過。
請同儕扮演 Agent，指出一項應停止詢問的歧義，再修正契約。
exercise.expected: 一份能交給另一人理解的任務契約，附責任分工、至少一個停止條件與驗收依據。
exercise.check: 同儕能說出誰決定規則、Agent 可以改哪裡，以及成功摘要還需要什麼證據；未實際執行時保持待驗證。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成契約與去識別化回饋；不要加入實際帳號、憑證或業務資料。

en.summary: Separate rule decisions, code changes, tool execution and acceptance so an AI-assisted task has clear owners, permissions and stop conditions.
objectives: Distinguish model suggestions, actions actually performed by tools and verified results.
Assign human and agent responsibilities for an intake-checking change.
Define the allowed change scope, acceptance criteria and stop conditions for ambiguity.

readingGuide.goal: Define human–agent responsibilities and an acceptance contract for one change task.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Begin with one requirement: a missing document type must prevent a complete-report export.
readingGuide.route: Assign responsibilities, trace the specification through changes, execution and acceptance, then write a task contract.
readingGuide.output: A responsibility appendix in problem.md and a reviewable agent task contract.

sections.heading: “Complete” Can Refer to Different Results
paragraphs: Here, a Coding Agent is a software agent that can help read a project, change code and call tools according to instructions. Its actual capabilities depend on its tools and environment configuration.

You ask a Coding Agent to change the intake website, and it replies, “Field validation is complete.” It might have generated code, or it might have changed files and run tests. To determine what can be delivered, inspect the changed files, actual commands, outputs and applicable scope.

The course uses three synthetic fields: application ID, applicant code and document type. Missing any required field must produce a missing-data message and block a complete report. The agent can help implement the rule; the person responsible for requirements must still confirm which fields are required and what “complete” means.

sections.heading: Like Delegating Work to a New Colleague
paragraphs: A new colleague may know how to program while being unfamiliar with your organization’s intake rules. Give them the purpose, reference documents, allowed change scope and questions that require stopping to ask, beyond “make it work.” AI collaboration needs these conditions too.

This analogy explains a delegation contract. Fluent agent responses do not automatically confer domain knowledge, data-use permission or release authority. Judge completed work through observable actions and artifacts.

sections.heading: Assign Owners for Rules, Execution and Acceptance
paragraphs: Separate requirements decisions, code changes, the execution environment and acceptance. One learner may hold several roles, but each responsibility still needs to be explicit. Tests check specified conditions; acceptance against work needs requires confirmed requirements. A diff lists before-and-after changes so you can inspect what actually changed.

NIST AI RMF 1.0 GOVERN 2.1 and 3.2 call for documented responsibilities, communication and human–AI roles. This lesson adapts that principle into a classroom assignment of responsibilities. It does not establish certification or compliance with the entire framework.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Example Responsibilities for This Course
rows: Decide the rules
The learner acts as requirements owner and confirms the three fields and the meaning of complete.
Rules and reasons in problem.md and spec.md
Propose and change code
The agent proposes a diff against the specification; the learner reviews it.
Changes to named files and decision records
Execute tools
The environment exposes only needed tools; the operator checks actual calls.
Commands, exit results and test output
Determine deliverable scope
The learner checks the specification, replays the task and involves a peer when needed.
Acceptance results, limits and next steps

sections.heading: Connect Suggestions to Evidence
paragraphs: A model can suggest a test command. A statement that “pytest passed” and an actual pytest tool execution are separately verifiable claims. Identify the directory and code version used, and whether the output covers this change.

Checking that an empty string is rejected does not establish that clearing a field after a successful check invalidates the old report. Choose a case that could disprove the success claim, reproduce it and inspect whether the change fixes the problem.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | A Reviewable Agent Task
blocks.description: Numbers show the basis for delivery. Ambiguity at any stage can lead back to a specification revision.

items.title: Confirm the specification
items.body: People define required fields, the complete state and exclusions first.

items.title: Delegate bounded changes
items.body: The agent changes only named files; new rules or extra services require a question first.

items.title: Check actual execution
items.body: Inspect the diff, tool commands, test output and changed version.

items.title: Decide and retain boundaries
items.body: People replay the target task and record passing scenarios and unverified scope.

sections.heading: Set Instructions, Permissions and Stop Conditions Together
paragraphs: “Do not change other files” describes the task scope. File permissions, a sandbox—an execution environment that limits accessible resources—and tool allowlists determine whether the system can restrict out-of-scope actions. A written reminder alone is not evidence of effective isolation. Check the actual environment and grant only the permissions needed for the task.

This task may allow reading problem.md and spec.md, and changing app.py, rules.py and named tests. It needs no production data, account secrets, external publication or paid external service. If the agent believes it must add a required field, install an unchecked dependency or change a file outside scope, it should first explain the reason and impact for the requirements owner to decide.

blocks.caption: Table 2 | A Task Contract You Can Give an Agent
rows: Goal
Show missing document type and reject complete-report export.
Basis
Use the current spec.md; do not invent business rules.
Change scope
Files in app.py, rules.py and tests/ relevant to this scenario.
Acceptance
Missing, complete, blank and stale-result scenarios, with actual command results.
Stop conditions
Ambiguous specification, need for real data, or actions beyond file or network permissions.
Delivery
Diff, actual execution record and unfinished work; people confirm deliverable scope.

sections.heading: Make Human Review an Actionable Arrangement
paragraphs: If the reviewer receives only a success summary, without time, tools or enough information to check it, a final confirmation click does not establish effective review. Limit the review to one slice: compare one requirement with one diff, then replay a case that should fail.

An agent error also gives you more options than simply asking again. Retain the failing input and output, identify the discrepancy with the specification, and ask for a correction and rerun. If the issue concerns the business definition of a required field, return the decision to the requirements owner; a longer prompt does not automatically resolve disagreement about rules.

exercise.environment: A text editor and the course’s synthetic intake scenario; no agent account or external service is needed.
steps: Add a responsibility section to problem.md, assigning rule decisions, code changes, tool operations and acceptance.
Use Table 2 to write an agent task contract with one missing-data scenario and allowed files.
Suppose you receive a “complete” summary. List the commands, diff or task evidence still needed to decide whether the scenario passed.
Have a peer act as the agent, identify an ambiguity that requires stopping to ask, then revise the contract.
exercise.expected: A task contract another person can understand, including responsibilities, at least one stop condition and an acceptance basis.
exercise.check: A peer can identify who decides rules, what the agent may change and which evidence a success summary still needs. Keep unexecuted work unverified.
exercise.cleanup: Retain the synthetic contract and de-identified feedback. Exclude actual accounts, credentials and business data.

zh.prompt: Agent 表示「測試都過了」，但沒有命令或輸出。下一步最合適的是？
options: 立刻宣告正式可用
請它提供對應版本的執行紀錄，並重演目標情境
把摘要存成測試證據即可
增加更多功能來確認能力
rationales: 正式可用還需更多需求與驗證，摘要不足以支持。
這讓主張連回實際操作、程式版本與規格結果。
摘要可以保留為回報，但尚不能證明工具執行與驗證範圍。
增加功能沒有補上目前缺少的證據。

en.prompt: The agent reports “all tests passed” without commands or output. What is the best next step?
options: Immediately declare production readiness.
Request execution records for the corresponding version and replay the target scenario.
Save the summary as sufficient test evidence.
Add more features to confirm capability.
rationales: Production readiness requires more requirements and verification than this summary supports.
This connects the claim to actual actions, the code version and specification outcomes.
A summary can be retained as a report, but does not yet establish tool execution or verified scope.
More features do not supply the missing evidence.

zh.prompt: Agent 發現規格沒有說文件類型是否必填，應如何處理？
options: 自己選一種規則並隱藏差異
改用更長 Prompt 後直接發布
列出歧義，請需求負責人確認，再同步規格與測試
刪掉該欄位以免出錯
rationales: 這會把未確認的規則當成事實。
提示長度無法取代業務決策與授權。
需求確認、規格與測試可共同維持同一條規則。
移除欄位仍是未獲確認的需求改動。

en.prompt: The specification does not say whether document type is required. What should the agent do?
options: Choose a rule and hide the discrepancy.
Use a longer prompt and publish immediately.
List the ambiguity, ask the requirements owner to confirm, then align the specification and tests.
Delete the field to avoid errors.
rationales: That would treat an unconfirmed rule as fact.
Prompt length cannot replace a business decision or authority.
Confirmed requirements, specifications and tests can maintain the same rule.
Removing the field is another unconfirmed requirements change.

zh.prompt: 哪一項能支持「Agent 只能修改指定範圍」的主張？
options: 它在回覆中答應不越界
提示最後加上驚嘆號
它產生的程式碼很少
已核對環境的檔案及工具權限，並檢查本次實際修改
rationales: 承諾是指令回應，尚未證明執行限制。
標點不會建立檔案或工具權限。
修改量小仍可能越界。
系統限制與事後證據分別支持允許範圍及本次實際行為。

en.prompt: Which evidence supports the claim that the agent can change only the specified scope?
options: It promised to stay in scope.
The prompt ends with an exclamation mark.
It generated very little code.
The environment’s file and tool permissions were checked, along with actual changes.
rationales: A promise responds to an instruction; it does not establish execution restrictions.
Punctuation creates no file or tool permissions.
A small change can still exceed scope.
System restrictions support allowed scope; the change record supports what happened in this task.
